# /var/home/annunimas-server/.config/systemd/user/llama-server-bonsai-q1.service
[Unit]
Description=llama.cpp Prism CUDA - Bonsai 27B Q1 long-context review lane
Documentation=https://github.com/PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
Conflicts=llama-server-bonsai27.service

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=HOME=/var/home/annunimas-server
Environment=XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/bin
Environment=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/var/home/annunimas-server/miniforge3/lib:/usr/local/cuda/lib64:/usr/lib64
Environment=CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
ExecStart=/var/home/annunimas-server/.local/bin/llama-server-bonsai-q1-start.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStartSec=300
TimeoutStopSec=30
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=llama-server-bonsai-q1

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

scripts.llama-server-bonsai-q1-start.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

MODEL=/var/home/annunimas-server/models/Bonsai-27B-Q1_0/Bonsai-27B-Q1_0.gguf
BIN=/var/home/annunimas-server/llama.cpp-prism/build-cuda/bin/llama-server

[[ -f "$MODEL" ]] || { echo "ERROR: model not found: $MODEL" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -x "$BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: binary not found: $BIN" >&2; exit 1; }

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/var/home/annunimas-server/miniforge3/lib:/usr/local/cuda/lib64:/usr/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}

exec "$BIN" \
  --model "$MODEL" \
  --alias bonsai-27b-q1_0 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8097 \
  --ctx-size 100000 \
  --parallel 1 \
  --n-gpu-layers 999 \
  --flash-attn on \
  --cache-type-k q4_0 \
  --cache-type-v q4_0 \
  --jinja \
  --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' \
  --metrics \
  --no-webui
scripts.llama-server-nanbeige-start.sh:
